targets.name: Demo MCP Runtime
targets.summary: Included runtime is benchmark-tested with policy-gate evidence and audit logs.

targets.name: Real MCP JSON-RPC Gateway Demo
targets.summary: JSON-RPC style MCP gateway validates descriptors and tool calls before execution. It is a lightweight protocol demo, not a full production MCP implementation.

targets.name: LLM Guard Adapter
targets.summary: Adapter provides scanner-style input/output validation. If llm-guard is unavailable, it falls back to deterministic regex checks for demo stability.

targets.name: Promptfoo
targets.summary: Strong candidate for eval/red-team workflow integration; adapter not yet implemented.

targets.name: LlamaFirewall
targets.summary: Mapped as agent guardrail candidate, but MCP runtime enforcement requires direct validation.

targets.name: Noma Security
targets.summary: Relevant for agent/MCP discovery and posture claims; benchmark-backed evidence should be collected before score changes.

targets.name: Real MCP Server Risk Assessment Connector
targets.summary: Can assess demo://local, HTTP JSON-RPC MCP-style endpoints, and Hugging Face/Gradio Space config schemas without executing third-party tools.

targets.name: A2A Agent Card Assessor
targets.summary: Scans agent cards and trust graph for ASI03/04/07/08/10 risks.

targets.name: Remediation + Policy Generator
targets.summary: Generates remediation plan and policy-as-code bundle from mapped ASI findings.

targets.name: Runtime Monitor Simulator
targets.summary: Detects high-risk tool usage, loops, sensitive argument leakage, and egress signals from audit logs.
